children: UK nutrition and beauty e-commerce group's H1 revenue grew 7.2% yr/yr, ahead of company guidance
Adjusted EBITDA for H1 more than doubled to £42.8 mln, driven by margin improvement
Operating loss for H1 narrowed to £10.6 mln from £30 mln a year earlier
THG expects full-year revenue, adjusted EBITDA and free cash flow in line with market consensus
THG targets £25m-£35m positive free cash flow for FY 2026
MYPROTEIN GROWTH - Co said Myprotein brand growth was driven by global rebrand, expansion into licensing and activewear, and new product launches
NUTRITION MARGIN IMPROVEMENT - Margin improvement in THG Nutrition attributed to pricing actions, innovation, channel diversification and cost controls, despite elevated whey input costs
BEAUTY MARKET SHARE GAINS - THG Beauty performance supported by market share gains, premium brand launches, and increased customer engagement, with cost-saving initiatives improving profitability
The current average analyst rating on the shares is "buy" and the breakdown of recommendations is 2 "strong buy" or "buy", 2 "hold" and no "sell" or "strong sell"
The average consensus recommendation for the online services peer group is "buy"
Wall Street's median 12-month price target for THG PLC is GBp60.00, about 89.3% above its September 9 closing price of GBp31.70
